column6: もう、大丈夫か？　だったら行くぞ。\nあまりもたもたしていると、悪魔どもが寄ってくるからな。\n
column7: You okay now? If so, let's go.\nIf we keep dawdling, the demons are gonna show up.\n

column6: 突然倒れたから、あわてて診てみたら、ぐーぐー寝てるんだもんね、あなた。\nこの年で脳卒中かっ！　とか、思っちゃった。\n
column7: You suddenly collapsed, and when I rushed over to check on you, you were just snoring away.\nI actually thought, 'A stroke, at your age!?'\n

column6: 泪は、わんわんと泣き始めた。\n
バカバカバカ！　いきなり消えたりして‥‥
column7: Idiot, idiot, idiot! Disappearing on me all of a sudden like that...

column6: なんだ、無事か。いきなり消えるから、何事かと思ったよ。\n
column7: Oh, you're okay. You vanished so suddenly, I thought something happened.\n

column6: 早坂のことを、英美に話すべきだろうか‥‥？\n
column7: Should he tell Emi about Hayasaka...?\n

column6: なぁんか、嘘っぽい。\nさては、アタシに言えないようなコト、してきたんでしょ！\n
column7: Hmm, sounds kinda fishy.\nI bet you went and did something you can't tell me about!\n

column6: とうっぶん口きかない！\n
column7: I'm not talking to you for a good long while!\n

column6: 泪はふくれて、そっぽを向いた。\n
column7: Rui puffs her cheeks out and turns away.\n

column6: 英美は流れてくる涙を、必死に掌でぬぐい続けた。\n
column7: Emi keeps desperately wiping away the tears streaming down her face.\n

column6: ありがとう、本当にありがとう‥‥。\n
column7: Thank you, thank you so much...\n

column6: なら、早くここを出なきゃ。
column7: Then we'd better get out of here quickly.

column6: じゃあ、地上で待ってる。迎えに来てね。\n
column7: Okay, I'll be waiting up on the surface. Come and get me, okay?\n

column6: 英美の魂は、地上へと還って行った‥‥\n
column7: Emi's soul returns to the surface above...\n

column6: わかった。ならば急ごう。出られなくなるぞ。\n
column7: Got it. Then let's hurry. We won't be able to get out otherwise.\n

column6: そうか。では、二度と会うこともあるまい‥‥\n
column7: I see. Then, I suppose we won't meet again...\n

column6: 今度は、地上のどこかで会おうね、
column7: Let's meet again somewhere up on the surface next time,

column6: ふたりの手が、握手を求めて差しだされる。握り返すと、途端に白い光が弾け‥‥\n
column7: Both of them reach out their hands for a handshake. The moment you take it, a burst of white light erupts...\n

column6: なら、これでさよならだ。二度と、会うこともあるまい‥‥。\n
column7: Then this is goodbye. I doubt we'll meet again...\n

column6: 今までの出来事を、英美にどう話そう……。\n
column7: How should he even explain everything that's happened to Emi......\n

column6: ともかく、心に浮かぶまま話すと、英美がつぶやくように言った。\n
column7: In any case, as he speaks whatever comes to mind, Emi murmurs something.\n

column6: そう、悪魔には逃げられちゃったんだ‥‥\n
column7: I see, so the demon got away...\n

column6: 今までの出来事をすべて、英美に話した。\n
column7: He tells Emi everything that has happened so far.\n

column6: じゃ、達也は元気なんだね。よかった。\n
column7: So Tatsuya's doing okay, then. That's a relief.\n

column6: シェルターで、きみたちと別れたあと‥‥
column7: After I split up with you two at the shelter...

column6: なんだって？　出されたものを、食っちまった？\n‥‥おまえ、意外と食い意地張ってるんだな‥‥\n
column7: What did you say? You ate what they served you?\n...You've got more of an appetite than I'd have guessed...\n

column6:
これは‥‥完全に、洗脳されたな。
何とか、洗脳を解除する方法を見つけないとな。
乱暴な手だが、別の洗脳を受けるとか‥‥
column7:
This is... she's been completely brainwashed.
I need to find some way to undo the brainwashing.
It's a rough method, but maybe getting brainwashed differently could work...

column6: ‥‥まだ、大丈夫だな。\n多少の影響はあるかもしれんが、どうにかなるさ、きっと。\n
column7: ...Still okay, I think.\nThere might be some effect, but it'll work out somehow, I'm sure.\n

column6:
‥‥きみがオレにしたことは、もう忘れよう。
ひとつだけ、教えてくれ。
‥‥あれから、英美はどうなった？
column7:
...I'll forget about what you did to me.
Just tell me one thing.
...What happened to Emi after that?

column7: I see, so she's doing well. That's a relief.\n

column7: ...You want me to come along and try to talk Emi around?\nThat might actually work, yeah.\n
There doesn't seem to be anyone around.\n

column6: 泪は、腕にしがみついてきた。\n
column7: Rui clings tightly to your arm.\n

column6: ねえ、ずうっと一緒にいてくれるんでしょ？\n
column7: Hey, you'll stay with me forever, right?\n

column6: ‥‥帰るところが、なくなっちゃった。\nアタシ、これから、どこに行けばいいの？\n
column7: ...I don't have anywhere to go back to anymore.\nWhere am I even supposed to go from here?\n

column6: 自分の行くところに、と答える
column7: Say she can come with you

column6: 何すんの、バカ！\nアンタなんか、助けるんじゃなかった！\n
column7: What are you doing, you idiot!\nI never should've saved you!\n

column6: ありがと‥‥これからも、ずっと一緒にいようね。\n
column7: Thanks... Let's stay together from now on, okay?\n

column6: ふぅん、なぁんにも言わないわけ？\nいいよーだ！　アンタなんか知らない！\n
column7: Hmph, so you're not gonna say anything at all?\nFine then! I don't even know you anymore!\n

column6:
‥‥そばに、いてくれるって、言ったよね？
だったら‥‥
その証を見せて。いいでしょ？
column7:
...You said you'd stay by my side, right?
So then...
Show me the proof. That's fine, isn't it?

column6: 泪の唇が、首筋に触れる‥‥\n
column7: Rui's lips brush against your neck...\n

column6:
‥‥ダメなの？　恋人がいるから？
それだったら、気にしなくていいの。
アタシ、今、アナタと一緒にいたいだけだもん。
column7:
...Is it no good? Because you have someone?
If that's it, you don't need to worry about that.
I just want to be with you right now, that's all.

column6: だから‥‥アナタと、ひとつになりたいの。それは、いけないこと？\n
column7: So... I want to become one with you. Is that so wrong?\n

column6: 泪は、首に腕を絡めようとしている。\n

Try to talk her out of it

column6: ‥‥なによ！　ほんとは、アタシを抱きたいくせに！\nつまらない意地なんか、張んないでよ！\n
column7: ...What's your problem!? You really want to hold me, don't you!\nDon't be so stubborn over nothing!\n

column6: うふっ、それでいいのよ。やっぱりアナタ、正直ね。\nだったら‥‥\n
column7: Heh, that's more like it. You really are honest, huh.\nIn that case...\n

column6: 泪の小さな手が身体にからみつき、服を一枚ずつ、脱がしていく‥‥\n
column7: Rui's small hands wrap around your body, undressing you piece by piece...\n

column6:

もう、死んじゃったひとなのに。
‥‥わかったわ。今言ったこと、忘れてちょうだい。
もう寝ましょ。おやすみなさい。
column7:
...You must really love her, huh.
Even though she's already gone.
...Fine. Forget what I just said.
Let's just go to sleep. Good night.
